about: Boss Battle audio (Tools/Audio/build_boss_audio.py; picks: boss_picks.py). Paths are relative to ninjago-unity/. Do not hand-edit.

BossRockThrow.trigger: At the release, end of the 0.8 s wind-up (arm above head, orange hand glow), as the rock leaves the hand.
BossRockThrow.notes: Giant effort grunt (-3 st) + deep wide whoosh: the throw reads as heavy; the whistle (801) carries the flight.

BossRockWhistle.trigger: Together with BossRockThrow: the rock is hurled up into the sky (air time 1.0 s); ~1.05 s, recedes upward.
BossRockWhistle.notes: Synth rising whistle with air noise (GDD 4.1 step 1 'whistle'): rises and fades out as the rock leaves the screen.

BossRockLock.trigger: When the reticle locks (turns magenta-red, '!' shakes). Beeps sit on the 6 Hz blink (0.167 s apart), 0.5 s.
BossRockLock.notes: Latch click + three rising beeps F6-G6-C7: 'locked on' reads instantly and is unlike any other cue.

BossRockImpact.trigger: When the rock lands (end of the 0.35 s fall), with the crater dust and shake.
BossRockImpact.notes: Stone demolish crack + debris rumble + deep stone thud + sub: heavy, instant (impact on the visual frame).

BossRoar.trigger: Ready beat (after 3-2-1), transform cutscene (0.8-2.0 s, with the BossAppear stinger), wake (with BossWake). Duck music.
BossRoar.notes: Deep monster roar (-2 st) for the body, alien roar (-5 st) for the bite, stone grind under it (a brick titan), sub weight.

BossGroundSlam.trigger: On the slam (both fists hit the ground after the 1.0 s red wind-up), with the shockwave ring and shake.
BossGroundSlam.notes: Hammer-impact boom (209 Hz centroid) + deep stone + rumble tail: the biggest ground hit in the mode.

BossBrickGrow.trigger: When a brick row starts growing out of the road (0.3 s grow, after its crack glowed). One per row, not per brick.
BossBrickGrow.notes: Fast Lego-click stack + a retro rising blip, landing on a real brick knock at 0.24 s: brick-built, readable, short.

BossMinionThrow.trigger: When the Titan releases the minion (end of the wind-up); the minion's 'wooah!' rides the start of the arc.
BossMinionThrow.notes: Titan grunt + throw whoosh + a small squeaky 'wooah!' (+6 st) for the flying skeleton minion: funny, not scary.

BossMinionLand.trigger: When the minion lands and clings on the car roof corner.
BossMinionLand.notes: Thunk on the car's roof plate + brick rattle + a tiny 'yah!': the minion is now ON the car.

BossMinionHit.trigger: Each minion damage tick (the minion whacks the car; 1 heart). BossVehicleHit plays too if the arena's hit path fires it.
BossMinionHit.notes: Metal whack on the roof + punch body + brick click: a sharp, short 'bonk' that says the minion is hurting the car.

BossWallGrow.trigger: When the side wall starts rising along the road edge (0.6 s rise).
BossWallGrow.notes: Brick grind + ten Lego clicks stacking up + a final brick knock at 0.58 s when the wall tops out.

BossWallSmash.trigger: When the car smashes the wall (wall bursts into bricks, minion scraped off). The success moment of the minion beat.
BossWallSmash.notes: Demolish crash + brick knock + a shower of Lego bricks: satisfying and toy-like.

BossPowerUpSpawn.trigger: When the rocket crate appears ahead ('Grab the rockets!').
BossPowerUpSpawn.notes: Bright rising C-major sparkle + crystal shimmer: positive, inviting, clearly not a hazard.

BossPowerUpPickup.trigger: When the car picks the crate up (before the volley launches).
BossPowerUpPickup.notes: Fast rising arpeggio + metal lock-and-load clunk at 0.28 s: 'rockets armed'.

BossRocketLaunch.trigger: Per rocket leaving the car roof (stagger 0.15 s; 3 pitch variants so a volley does not phase).
BossRocketLaunch.notes: Deep rocket launch + bright exhaust hiss + a small pop at t=0 for the instant of launch.

BossRocketHit.trigger: Per rocket hitting the boss's chest (with hit-stop and flinch). Also the right sound for the finale's chained ExplodeSmall bursts (short, chain-safe).
BossRocketHit.notes: Punchy explosion with an arcade transient on frame 0, brick debris rattle and a boss-mass thud; 3 RR variants.

BossHurt.trigger: Boss flinch after a volley lands (once per volley, after the rocket hits), and on big laser damage if wanted.
BossHurt.notes: Pained monster groan (-3 st) + a stone crack in the Titan's bricks: 'it hurts' and 'it is breaking'.

BossTakeOff.trigger: Transform cutscene 2.0 s: the Titan leaps, wings unfold (flap at 0 and 0.45 s), jets ignite (from ~0.35 s).
BossTakeOff.notes: Big wing flaps + rising turbine whine + afterburner roar: the Titan becomes a flying boss.

BossTransform.trigger: Transform cutscene 3.2 s: the car bursts into bricks (t=0), rebuilds into the ninja jet (clicks 0.6-2.2 s, faster and louder), snaps together at 2.3 s (= cutscene 5.5 s, just before lift-off).
BossTransform.notes: Brick burst + Lego shower, a riser and an accelerating Lego-click rebuild ending in a snap + chime: toy-like assembly.

BossDevilWind.trigger: When the Titan blows a gust barrage (after the 0.8 s violet wind-up); once per barrage row is fine (~1.8 s).
BossDevilWind.notes: Howling storm gust + deep whoosh + the Titan's huge breath (-4 st): wind that comes from the boss.

BossTired.trigger: When the Titan slumps after a barrage (Zzz, 'It's tired - FIRE!').
BossTired.notes: Exhausted monster pant (-3 st) + a falling slide whistle: comic 'out of breath' cue that invites the attack.

BossLaserLoop.trigger: SfxManager.StartLoop while the plane auto-fires (8 bolts/s = config laser.fireInterval 0.125 s); StopLoop on wake. Exactly 1.000 s = 8 bolts; start it on the first bolt so the pews line up with the visuals.
BossLaserLoop.notes: Retro 'pew' bolts (4 pitch steps, cycled) + a sampled blaster transient over an 8 Hz-pulsed energy hum; seamless.

BossLaserHit.trigger: When a bolt strikes the Core (on target). Can fire up to 8/s; SfxManager's 35 ms throttle is fine.
BossLaserHit.notes: Short energy impact + crushed zap: crunchy 'damage' confirmation, 0.3 s max so 8/s never smears.

BossWake.trigger: When the Titan wakes at a notch (70/30/5 %): shockwave, laser stops. Pair with BossRoar if the roar is wanted too.
BossWake.notes: Downward shockwave sweep + angry growl (-3 st) + energy pulse: the wake reads as a blast, not just a voice.

BossClapInhale.trigger: At the start of the clap inhale (0.8 s, white palms); the file is 0.80 s and stops dead where the blow (push) starts.
BossClapInhale.notes: Rising band-passed air swell + reversed breath: a huge inhale that cuts off right before the blow.

BossClapWarning.trigger: When the 'DIVE!' warning starts (vertical control returns; 1.8 s normal / 2.2 s large). One shot, 0.95 s.
BossClapWarning.notes: Two submarine 'ah-OO-gah' dive klaxon calls: literally 'DIVE!', the most urgent cue in the mode.

BossSpikeSlam.trigger: When the spiked walls smash together (0.22 s slam).
BossSpikeSlam.notes: Hammer boom + metal demolish + trap snap: the heaviest metallic hit (2-heart hazard).

BossExplode.trigger: Finale ExplodeBig (the final burst: parts fly apart into a brick shower), and the knockout vehicle burst if wanted. Use BossRocketHit for the chained ExplodeSmall bursts.
BossExplode.notes: Long bright explosion with falling debris and a 1 s Lego brick shower: the Titan comes apart into bricks.

BossVehicleHit.trigger: Every hazard hit on the car/jet (brick, rock, minion tick, wind, spike), with the i-frame blink.
BossVehicleHit.notes: Plastic-and-metal crunch + brick rattle + a falling 'bwomp': clearly 'you got hit', distinct from boss hits.

BossKnockout.trigger: Hearts reach 0: the vehicle tumbles and bursts (with hit-stop / slow-mo); then the Defeat stinger and BossLaugh.
BossKnockout.notes: Crash into a pile of bricks + a cartoon 'wah wah wah waaah': a soft, kid-friendly fail.

BossBannerSlam.trigger: When a banner slams in (BOSS name, PHASE 1/2, WAKE, VICTORY!, KNOCKED OUT), on the frame it lands.
BossBannerSlam.notes: Taiko drum + stone thud + cymbal shimmer + brick snap: a dramatic ninja 'BOOM' under the banner.

BossLaserDeflect.trigger: When a bolt misses and glances off the armour ('tink', no damage). Up to 8/s; keep it quiet.
BossLaserDeflect.notes: Small inharmonic metal tink: audible feedback that the shot missed, never louder than a hit.

BossCountdown.trigger: On each Ready digit 3, 2, 1 (one shot per digit, 0.3 s); BossRoar acts as the 'GO'.
BossCountdown.notes: A5 arcade beep over a low brick-drum knock: crisp, the same pitch for each digit.

BossLaugh.trigger: Knockout: the Titan laughs (after the crash, ~1 s into the 3 s knockout).
BossLaugh.notes: A villain 'ha-ha-ha' pitched down 6 st with a growl under it: big and goofy-menacing, kid-safe.

BossCrackGlow.trigger: When a row's crack line starts glowing (0.45 s before its bricks grow). One per row.
BossCrackGlow.notes: Stone crack + a swelling, trembling hot hum: warns 'something is coming out of the ground here'.

BossBattleRoad.source: music-cell-shared-assets/Assets/Ultimate Game Music Collection/Combat/Boss Battle 2 Loop.wav
BossBattleRoad.licence: Ultimate Game Music Collection (royalty-free asset-store music pack, team-licensed; music-cell-shared-assets)
BossBattleRoad.notes: Phase 1 road (dusk). ~150 BPM, steady 8th-note drive for the whole loop (LRA 4.4, centroid 305 Hz), 83.2 s = 52 bars, perfectly continuous wrap. Not used by any other mode (fingerprinted against every Assets/Audio/Bgm loop; Boss Battle 1 is BilliardRogue's Boss).

BossBattleSky.source: music-cell-shared-assets/Assets/Ultimate Game Music Collection/Combat/Boss Battle 5 Loop.wav
BossBattleSky.licence: Ultimate Game Music Collection (royalty-free asset-store music pack, team-licensed; music-cell-shared-assets)
BossBattleSky.notes: Phase 2 sky (storm night). Same series and key centre as the road loop (smooth transform crossfade), darker (centroid 190 vs 305 Hz, 83 % of its energy under 200 Hz) and busier (4.6 vs 3.8 onsets/s); 80.0 s = 40 bars with a built-in swell back into the top; perfectly continuous wrap. Unused elsewhere.

sfx.why: files are already mono and loudness-matched; forceToMono+normalize (KidsAudio.Import) would re-normalise every clip to 0 dBFS and undo the levels; preload avoids a first-play hitch

bgm.why: as KidsAudio.RegisterMusic and the other Ninjago loops (quality 1 = importer default); keep the exact sample count (no trimming) so AudioSource.loop wraps seamlessly
